text.card: A star about 100 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 10.8 solar radii and 3.00 solar masses (FLAME) and 4,943 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: HD 104985
quotes.card: HD 104985, formally named Tonatiuh, is a solitary star with an exoplanetary companion in the northern constellation of Camelopardalis.
quotes.introduction: The companion is designated HD 104985 b and named Meztli.
